root.title: Cosmo: tasks, habits and OKRs in one free app
root.description: Tasks, habits, calendar and OKRs together in one free app. Try the demo without signing up, preloaded with 12 months of data.

guide.title: Cosmo user guide – Tasks, habits, OKRs and calendar
guide.description: Learn how to use Cosmo: tasks, habits with a heatmap, time-blocking calendar and OKR tracking. The complete guide.
guide.articleDescription: A complete guide to using Cosmo: task management, habit tracking with a heatmap, time-blocking calendar and the OKR method.

about.description: Why Cosmo exists: a free, independent productivity app bringing tasks, habits, calendar and OKRs into a single ecosystem.

enterprisePresentation.title: Cosmo for Companies: your whole company in one place
enterprisePresentation.description: Tasks, projects, OKRs and teams, with custom roles and a scope per team. Free up to 5 members, no credit card. Every teammate keeps their personal Cosmo.

blog.title: Cosmo blog: productivity, OKRs, habits and time-blocking
blog.description: Practical guides on the OKR method, habit tracking, time-blocking and personal productivity. From the Cosmo team.

templates.title: Free templates: OKRs, routines and planners | Cosmo
templates.description: Free templates to fill in: OKRs for freelancers, students or startups, morning routine, revision timetable, weekly review. Full examples, no sign-up.

eisenhowerTool.title: Eisenhower matrix online: free tool | Cosmo
eisenhowerTool.description: Sort your tasks in an online Eisenhower matrix, free and with no sign-up: urgent, important, schedule, delegate. Printable.

okrGeneratorTool.title: Free OKR generator: objectives and key results | Cosmo
okrGeneratorTool.description: A free OKR generator with no sign-up: pick an area, phrase your objective and get key results to adjust. Copy or print the result.

habitTrackerTool.title: Custom printable habit tracker: free tool | Cosmo
habitTrackerTool.description: Build your own habit tracker: pick the month and your habits, then print a grid ready to tick. Free, no sign-up.

weeklyPlannerTool.title: Weekly planner online: free time blocking | Cosmo
weeklyPlannerTool.description: Plan your week with time blocking: a Monday-to-Sunday grid to fill in and print, free and with no sign-up. Work blocks, meetings, buffers.

pomodoroTool.title: Online Pomodoro timer: free, no sign-up | Cosmo
pomodoroTool.description: Online Pomodoro timer: focused work sessions, short breaks and a long break after each cycle. Free, no sign-up, with your current task.
